newsitem.title: USA: Arbor Drugs sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Arbor Drugs sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Arbor Drugs Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors declared a three-for-two stock split to be effected in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend.
The new shares will be distributed on December 17 to shareholders of record as of December 3.
"By increasing the number of shares available in the marketplace, the liquidity of Arbor stock should improve," Chairman Eugene Applebaum said in a statement.
This is the fourth stock split Arbor has declared in its 10 years as a public company.
As a result of this stock split, the previously announced quarterly cash dividend of $.085 a share will now be $.06, payable on January 7, to holders of record December 10.
Arbor Drug's weighted average primary shares outstanding for the fiscal first quarter ended October 31 totaled 25.1 million.
